notes: The detail header is the sanitized path; Sj renders only when the host renders elements, so the badge text comes from the source children and the badge component is asserted by identity.

A readable file is resolved against the project cwd, read through the 1 MB bound, and rendered as one H4 per hunk with the first line and full content; a missing or oversized file degrades to firstLine null and fileContent undefined.
Restricted, untracked, binary and large files never read the file; untracked adds the local git add hint because isRemoteSession is false.
The divider repeats yV and centers a title as `<left> <title> <right>`, falling back to children when the screen reader is off.
